name: Soroban Kaikei
description: Soroban Kaikei — a small-business tax accountant theme with a formal top header whose menu is split either side of the centred office name, with a Book a free first talk button. Keshizumi charcoal (#524748) is the main colour: the hero field, every page head, the services column, the calendar band and the overlay menu are charcoal fields with a 2D flat abacus-bead and ledger-line pattern multiplied in, set in white and light ochre. The hero is a diagonal split: the charcoal field cut on a slant beside the office illustration, with a cut-out abacus on a ledger lying across the seam and breaking over the hero edge. Sticky media: the services column with the adviser picture stays in view while four service cards scroll, and each Services picture stays beside its notes. A cut-out seal stamp breaks over the calendar band. Every picture is a 2D flat illustration. Zen Kaku Gothic New for display, Plus Jakarta Sans for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-30 (sticky-media, diagonal-split hero, split nav, pattern-texture, 2d-flat, keshizumi #524748, Zen Kaku Gothic New + Plus Jakarta Sans). A formal top header (office name, menu split three left and two right of the centred name, Book a free first talk button; overlay menu on phones and tablets). Sticky media: on home the charcoal column with the title and the adviser picture stays in view while four service cards scroll, and on Services each picture stays in view beside its notes. Pattern texture: a 2D flat abacus-bead and ledger-line pattern multiplied into every charcoal field and behind the journal. Break-frame: the cut-out abacus and ledger (transparent WebP) lie across the hero diagonal seam between the charcoal field and the office illustration and break over the hero bottom edge into the office board; the cut-out seal stamp breaks over the top edge of the calendar band; the abacus sits across the diagonal seam of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Sans TC subset (gothic, the closest to Zen Kaku Gothic New).

summary.zh-TW: 消炭灰的小型稅務事務所：斜切分割主視覺、固定側欄圖像、算盤圖紋與去背算盤破格；扁平插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A charcoal tax office for small shops: a diagonal split hero, a sticky picture column and a cut-out abacus breaking the seam.
summary.ja: 消炭色の小さな税理士事務所。斜めに切った主画面、止まる画像の列、そろばん文様、枠を破る切り抜きのそろばん。五か国語付き。
summary.fr: Un cabinet fiscal anthracite : héros coupé en diagonale, colonne d’image fixe et boulier détouré qui déborde.
summary.de: Ein anthrazitfarbenes Steuerbüro: diagonal geteilter Hero, mitlaufende Bildspalte und ein freigestellter Abakus.
